tools.name: drinkedin_plan_night_out
tools.description: Plans a walkable 2-4 stop night out around a place, using only venues DrinkedIn has validated against an official licence register or premises census, or the venue's own site, and books nothing. Free. Side effect: saves the planned route (public venue data only, 30 days) for its share link, returned

tools.name: drinkedin_get_guide
tools.description: Returns reference data for the night-out planner: some places with validated venues (not a ranking and not a coverage claim; places, styles and vibes are built from the venues on record and the planner's style and vibe tables), supported vibes, route styles, and notes on addresses and place names. N

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "drinkedin_plan_night_out" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
